title: Barron Trump towers over Melania at 6ft 7ins during Mar-a-Lago Easter brunch - NewsBreak
text:
By James Liddell Yelena Mandenberg ,
26 minutes ago Donald Trump's towering teenage son was seen standing tall next to his mother Melania as they paused for an Easter Brunch.
The Trump family made a full appearance on Sunday, March 31, donning their finest Easter attire at the former president's Mar-a-Lago resort in Florida . Standing at an impressive 6ft 7ins, 18-year-old Barron Trump looked quite stylish in his two-piece navy suit, complemented with a bright yellow tie, as he walked alongside his mother.
They were also accompanied by Melania's father, Victor Knavs. Melania, 53, has been largely out of the public eye – including her husband's New York court hearings – due to the passing of her mother earlier this year.

This has sparked rumors that she is not in a rush to join her 77-year-old husband on the campaign trail. Now, the former First Lady appeared radiant as she wore a flowing white dress while walking proudly next to her tall son.
Father Donald, who stands at 6ft 3in, has often humorously remarked about how Barron favored football over basketball despite his height. Trump was also seen wearing a yellow 'Make America Great Again' baseball cap – matching Barron's tie – as he spent time with his grandchildren.
The former president's daughter-in-law Lara Trump shared a video of him embracing her children on X. She captioned it: "'When Grandpa wears the Easter MAGA."
While the Trump family appeared cheerful in public, the former U.S. president shared a far less upbeat message on his Truth Social platform on Sunday. Writing entirely in capitals, he targeted what he described as "crooked and corrupt prosecutors and judges" attempting to "interfere" with the November 2024 U.S. presidential election, alleging they were conspiring to have him imprisoned.

Special Counsel Jack Smith, Fulton County District Attorney Fani Willis, Manhattan District Attorney Alvin Bragg and President Joe Biden were all targeted in his tirade. Smith was labeled "evil and sick"; Willis was attacked over her relationship with senior deputy Nathan Wade; Bragg was dismissed as "lazy"; and Biden was accused of directing his Department of Justice "thugs" to "illegally" indict Trump.
The former president wrapped up his tirade with: "Happy Easter everyone!"
Trump flew back to Florida following a challenging week in New York, where an appeals court granted a delay in collecting the ex-president's $454 million civil fraud penalty if he posts a $175 million bond within 10 days after the original deadline passed last Monday.
The court simultaneously scheduled his hush-money criminal trial – an unprecedented proceeding for a former U.S. president. On March 22, Judge Juan Merchan scheduled the trial for April 15, denying the former president's legal team's requests to postpone it by at least 90 days. The case against Trump alleges he incorrectly documented payments to Michael Cohen, his personal attorney at the time, as legal expenses when they were actually intended to suppress damaging stories about him during the 2016 campaign.
This includes $130,000 Cohen allegedly paid Stormy Daniels on behalf of Trump so she wouldn't share her story of a past sexual encounter with him. However, the Republican claimed that he did not have sex with Daniels and his lawyers have said that the money given to Cohen was for legal costs, and nothing more clandestine.
Trump has recently been issued a gag order that prevented him from publicly discussing witnesses, prosecutors, court staff, and jurors in the trial. Judge Juan Merchan imposed the order following a series of "threatening" posts on his social media platform, Truth Social.
